title: Chapter 7196: Crushing Tribulations Bare Handed

Chapter 7196: Crushing Tribulations Bare Handed

Chapter 7196: Crushing Tribulations Bare Handed

Octopus’ tentacles also released tribulations while keeping Li Qiye’s in place. Keep in mind that this creature’s physical body was above Phoenix Queen and Heavenfall.

“High Heaven Death!” It whispered in an ancient language, releasing an affinity killing everything.

“Lightness Erasure!” Heavenfall unleashed his apex power for a direct attack.

As for Genesis, he unleashed a temporal wave attempting to drag Li Qiye’s true fate and powers to the future, splitting him in half.

Their most powerful strikes made space and time caved inward. It appeared as if Li Qiye was being crushed by the impact.

“Not bad, may be enough to remove some fog, but truly insufficient still.” Li Qiye smiled.

It was as if he rebounded from the caved plane, bursting out in the blink of an eye with unstoppable force.

It obliterated the eight tentacles, causing Octopus to scream while hurled through space. Since Genesis tried to drag him to the future, his movement broke down the barrier between the present and future, resulting in a force ripping Genesis apart. It was as if he wore dragged across an endless plane.

Heavenfall was met with his own technique. Although he was the most capable of withstanding it, he barely survived and spat blood wildly. Cracks appeared across his body.

“Ahh!” Phoenix Queen fared even worse since she was the main target, being hit by Li Qiye’s knee.

After crashing through dimensions, she resembled a puddle of flesh and blood.

The result left spectators speechless. These four were the strongest in the mortal world, capable of slaughtering the rest. However, they couldn’t withstand a single move from Li Qiye.

“Above the high heaven.” An immortal murmured.

“Crackle!” Tribulation bolts surged on the falally injured combatants and healed their wounds, allowing them to assume their best state.

“Sir, as long as the high heaven is there, we cannot die, we are eternal just like the tribulations.” Phoenix Queen said.

Listeners shuddered because if this was true, they would be unstoppable. No one could survive the tribulations forever.

“I’m afraid even the high heaven is not eternal when the opponent is me, let alone you all.” Li Qiye smiled and began gathering tribulations between his palms.

They struggled like a wild beast feeling threatened, attacking his flesh. Alas, they wouldn’t escape and were gradually being reduced to nothingness. Finally, these bolts turned into smoke, no longer existing.

Spectators had no idea one could deal with the tribulations in this manner. They dropped to the ground, frozen.

Phoenix Queen and her allies staggered backward, seemingly struck by lightning. How could someone destroy tribulation bolts with his bare hands?
